title: Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract — Schedule of Covered Components and Exclusions by Plan
content:
The scope of repair coverage under the Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract is fixed by the plan the holder bought. Each plan is written either as a **stated component** plan, which covers only the component groups listed for it, or as an **exclusionary** plan, which covers everything except the listed exclusions.

## Schedule

| Plan | Coverage type | Component groups covered | Hybrid and EV drive components | Infotainment, navigation and driver-assist electronics | Seals and gaskets of covered parts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | Stated component | Engine; transmission; drive axle | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered |
| Kestrel Care Gold | Stated component | Engine; transmission; drive axle; steering; brakes; air conditioning | Not covered | Not covered | Covered |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | Stated component | Engine; transmission; drive axle; steering; brakes; air conditioning; electrical; fuel system | Covered | Not covered | Covered |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | Exclusionary | All components except the listed exclusions | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | Exclusionary | All components except the listed exclusions | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | Exclusionary | All components except the listed exclusions | Covered | Covered | Covered |

## Exclusions

| Plan | Wear and maintenance item never covered | Paint, trim and upholstery | Failures that existed before purchase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Powertrain | Brake pads | Excluded | Excluded |
| Kestrel Care Gold | Rotors | Excluded | Excluded |
| Kestrel Care Gold Plus | Wiper blades | Excluded | Excluded |
| Kestrel Care Platinum | Tires | Excluded | Excluded |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | Batteries | Excluded | Excluded |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | Bulbs | Excluded | Excluded |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- On a stated component plan, a component group that does not appear in that plan's list of covered groups is outside the plan.
- On an exclusionary plan the covered scope is everything except the listed exclusions: the plan's excluded wear item, cosmetic items where paint, trim and upholstery are excluded, and any group switched off for that plan in the hybrid and EV, electronics or seals and gaskets columns. On the three exclusionary plans none of those three groups is switched off.
- The hybrid and EV, electronics and seals and gaskets columns state for every plan whether that group is covered.

### Illustrations (hypothetical repair lines)

- A hypothetical steering failure on a Kestrel Care Powertrain plan: steering is not in that plan's list of covered groups, so the line falls outside the plan's coverage.
- A hypothetical navigation-unit failure on a Kestrel Care Gold Plus plan: electronics are not covered on that plan, so the line falls outside its coverage.
- A hypothetical worn set of tires on a Kestrel Care Platinum plan: tires are that plan's excluded wear item, so the line falls outside its coverage, while the same failure is not that plan's excluded wear item on a Kestrel Care Platinum Elite plan, whose excluded wear item is bulbs.
